subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: Should the new cross-provider model total include overlapping local-history and provider-reported sources, or should the feature deduplicate/exclude a defined source set before presenting totals?
rationale: The implementation intentionally aggregates sources without deduplication, while the linked design discussion identifies double counting as a central accuracy concern; code review cannot choose the permanent user-facing policy safely.

options.title: Define a non-overlapping aggregate
options.body: Exclude or deduplicate known overlapping local/provider sources and test the selected source-precedence rule before merge.

options.title: Ship a scoped raw-source view
options.body: Retain the current aggregation only if the product explicitly defines it as raw, potentially overlapping source history and makes that limitation clear in the UI.

options.title: Pause Scope B aggregation
options.body: Keep per-source model reporting and defer cross-provider totals until source identity and overlap handling have an approved design.

recommendation.title: Define a non-overlapping aggregate
recommendation.body: Exclude or deduplicate known overlapping local/provider sources and test the selected source-precedence rule before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product contract for user-visible accounting totals rather than a mechanical rendering repair.
